title: 第110章 封神之战，又将开启！
slug: 先秦炼气两千年世人误闯天家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“商纣之战，表面上，是我阐教奉天命，助西周，伐无道之君，重整人伦。实则，是天道杀劫降临，亦是我阐、截二教，了结因果，定鼎封神榜上名额的仙人之战。”

“在那场战争中，我阐教有元始师祖算计，又有太上师伯相助，门下十二金仙，皆是应劫之人，占据了天时地利。”

“而截教，虽有通天师叔‘有教无类’的万仙来朝之势，但门下弟子良莠不齐，多是湿生卵化之辈，根行浅薄，因果缠身，早已注定了败亡的结局。”

杨戬说到这里，声音顿了顿，似乎是在组织语言，该如何提及长青仙宗。

749局指挥中心里，老天师等人听得是如痴如醉。

这些，都是道门典籍中零星记载，语焉不详的片段。

今天，他们却从一位亲身经历者的口中，听到了最原始，最真实的版本。

这对于他们这些修道者来说，不亚于一场闻道之会！

“他说的，和我们典籍记载的大致相同。阐教胜，截教败，最终三百六十五位截教仙人上了封神榜，成就了天庭正神，但也从此失去了自由之身，受天规束缚。”老天师在一旁补充道。

“那……长青仙宗呢？”周玄策问出了所有人都关心的问题。

就在这时，杨戬的声音再次响起。

“然而……在这场早已注定了结局的战争中，却出现了一个最大的变数。”

“这个变数，就是……长青仙宗。”

杨戬的声音，带上了一丝复杂的意味，既有敬畏，也有一丝不解。

“长青仙宗，自古长存，其道统之源，无人知晓。它不属于阐教，不属于截教，更不属于西方教，它独立于所有圣人道统之外，自成一脉。”

“其门下弟子，代代单传，每一代，都只有一位。但每一位，都是足以搅动三界风云的绝世人物。”

“在封神之战开启之时，长青仙宗的第四代祖师，刚刚坐化。其传承，落到了第五代祖师，也就是……闻仲太师的身上。”

“闻仲太师，本是截教金灵圣母的弟子，但他得到长青仙宗传承之后，其身份，便已超然于截教之外。”

“按照长青仙宗‘不沾因果，不入杀劫’的古训，他本不该参与那场战争。”

“但是……”杨戬的声音，变得有些低沉。

“为了他截教的同门，为了他身为商朝太师的职责，他还是……毅然决然地，踏入了杀劫之中。”

“他以一人之力，执掌商周战局。布下十绝大阵，力抗我阐教十二金仙。我阐教弟子，在其面前，几乎无人能敌。若非后来几位师伯、师叔亲自下场，以大欺小，破了他的阵法……”

杨戬说到这里，声音中竟然带上了一丝羞愧。

“可以说，整个封神之战的前半段，几乎就是闻仲太师一人，对抗我整个阐教的战争！”

“他的存在，甚至一度让我等怀疑，天命，是否真的在西周。”

听到这里，749局指挥中心的所有人，都彻底失声了。

他们脑海中，仿佛浮现出了一副画面。

一个身穿黑甲，额生神眼，手持双鞭的孤傲身影，独自一人，站在两军阵前。

他的对面，是阐教的千军万马，是那传说中的十二金仙。

而他，却以一人之力，撑起了整个摇摇欲坠的商朝，撑起了整个截教的命运。

这是何等的悲壮！何等的豪情！

“那……那后来呢？”王斌忍不住追问道，“他不是……战死了吗？”

杨戬的声音，变得更加苦涩。

“是……也不是。”

“闻仲太师最终力竭，误入绝龙岭，此乃天数，非人力所能及。”

“但在他身死道消，魂魄将要上封神榜的那一刻，异变……发生了。”

“长青仙宗的第六代祖师，出现了。”

“无人知晓他是谁，无人知晓他从何而来。他只做了一件事。”

“他从封神榜下，从天道规则之中，硬生生地，将闻仲太师的真灵，给……抢了回来。”

“他从封神榜下，从天道规则之中，硬生生地，将闻仲太师的真灵，给……抢了回来。”

杨戬这句话，说得异常艰难。

每一个字，都仿佛重若千钧，砸在749局指挥中心每一个人的心上。

“抢……抢回来？”

周玄策的嘴巴张得能塞下一个鸡蛋，他感觉自己的听力可能出了问题。

“从封神榜下面……抢人？这……这是什么意思？”

老天师的脸色，已经不能用苍白来形容了，那是一种混杂着极致恐惧和极致狂热的潮红。

他死死地抓着桌子的边缘，指节因为用力而发白，声音颤抖地解释道：

“封神榜……乃是天道法器！是鸿钧道祖亲赐，用来稳定天地秩序，了结仙道杀劫的无上宝物！”

“一旦有仙人身死，其真灵便会被封神榜自动吸取，名列其上，化为天庭正神。这个过程，是天道法则的直接体现，是不可逆转，不可违抗的！”

“违抗，就是与天道为敌！就是与鸿钧道祖为敌！”

老天师说到这里，猛地倒吸了一口凉气，他看着屏幕，眼神像是看着一个疯子。

“长青仙宗的第六代祖师……他……他竟然敢在封神榜下面抢人？他这是在……公然叫板天道啊！”

“我的天……”

指挥中心里，响起一片倒吸凉气的声音。

他们终于明白，杨戬为什么会如此恐惧了。

这是一个什么样的宗门啊！

第五代的祖师，以一人之力，对抗整个阐教。

第六代的祖师，更是猛到直接去跟天道抢人！

这已经不是“强大”两个字可以形容的了。

这是疯子！是一群完全不按常理出牌的，无法无天的疯子！

而现在，这个疯子宗门的第二十代传人，就站在这里。

谁能不怕？谁敢不怕？

杨戬的声音，带着回忆的余悸，继续从天外传来。

“那位六代祖师，将闻仲太师的真灵抢回之后，并未久留。他只是对着手持封神榜的姜子牙师叔，以及在场的我等所有阐教仙人，说了一句话。”

“他说……”杨戬的声音顿了顿，似乎是在模仿那位六代祖师的语气。

“‘今日之因，三千年后，我长青仙宗，自会来取一个果。’”

“说完，他便带着闻仲太师的真灵，消失在了天地之间。从此，长青仙宗，彻底隐世，三千年间，再无任何消息。”

“直到……今日。”

杨戬的故事，讲完了。

但它带来的震撼，却如同海啸一般，一波又一波地冲击着所有人的心灵。

今日之因，三千年后，我长青仙宗，自会来取一个果。

一句何等霸道的宣言！

封神之战，阐教大胜，截教覆灭，天庭建立，这是天道定下的结局。

可长青仙宗，偏偏不认！

他抢走了本该上封神榜的闻仲太死。

留下了一句三千年后再来算账的狠话。

这意思就是：你们今天让我不爽了，这事没完。你们先得意三千年，三千年后，我再来找你们连本带利地讨回来！

这是何等的霸气！何等的无法无天！

"The battle between Shang and Zhou, on the surface, was about me interpreting and teaching to fulfill the destiny of heaven, helping the Western Zhou Dynasty, defeating the unruly kings, and reorganizing human relations. In reality, it was the coming of heaven's killing calamity, and it was also a battle between the immortals in which I interpreted and intercepted the two religions, settled the cause and effect, and determined the place on the list of gods in the tripod."

"During that war, I was informed by Master Yuanshi's plans, and I was assisted by my Supreme Master. The twelve golden immortals under my sect were all in danger of the disaster, and they occupied the right place at the right time."

"As for Jie Jiao, although Uncle Tongtian has the potential to teach thousands of immortals, his disciples are mixed, good and bad. Most of them are those who have become wet and born with eggs. They have shallow roots and are entangled in cause and effect. They are already doomed to defeat."

When Yang Jian said this, his voice paused, as if he was organizing his words on how to mention the Evergreen Immortal Sect.

In the command center of the 749th Bureau, Lao Tianshi and others listened in ecstasy.

These are all scattered and unclear fragments recorded in Taoist classics.

Today, they heard the most original and authentic version from a person who had experienced it personally.

For these ascetics, this is no less than a meeting to hear the Tao!

"What he said is roughly the same as what is recorded in our classics. The Chan Jiao won and the Jie Jiao lost. In the end, the 365 Jie Jiao immortals were on the list of gods and became the gods of heaven, but they also lost their freedom and were bound by the rules of heaven." The old Heavenly Master added at the side.

"What about... the Evergreen Immortal Sect?" Zhou Xuance asked the question that everyone was concerned about.

At this moment, Yang Jian's voice sounded again.

"However... in this war that has long been destined to end, one of the biggest variables has appeared."

"This variable is... the Evergreen Immortal Sect."

Yang Jian's voice had a complex meaning, a mixture of awe and confusion.

"The Evergreen Immortal Sect has existed since ancient times, and no one knows the origin of its orthodoxy. It does not belong to the Chan Sect, the Jie Sect, and it does not belong to the Western Sect. It is independent of all saints' orthodoxy and forms its own lineage."

"His disciples are passed down from generation to generation, and there is only one in each generation. But each one is a peerless figure who can stir up troubles in the three realms."

"When the Battle of the Gods began, the fourth-generation patriarch of the Evergreen Immortal Sect had just passed away. His inheritance fell to the fifth-generation patriarch, Grand Master Wen Zhong."

"Master Wen Zhong was originally a disciple of the Holy Mother of the Golden Spirit of the Jie Jiao, but after he received the inheritance from the Evergreen Immortal Sect, his identity has transcended the Jie Jiao."

"According to the ancient motto of the Evergreen Immortal Sect, 'Don't be involved in cause and effect, don't be involved in killings', he shouldn't have participated in that war."

"But..." Yang Jian's voice became a little deeper.

"For the sake of his fellow disciples and for his duty as the Grand Master of the Shang Dynasty, he still... resolutely stepped into the murderous calamity."

"He single-handedly took charge of the Shang and Zhou wars. He set up ten great formations to resist the twelve golden immortals of my teachings. The disciples of my teachings were almost unbeatable in front of him. If it hadn't been for several senior uncles and uncles who later personally came to the scene and bullied the small ones, breaking his formation..."

When Yang Jian said this, there was a hint of shame in his voice.

"It can be said that in the first half of the entire Conferred God War, it was almost only Grand Master Wen Zhong who fought against my entire teaching!"

"His existence even made us doubt whether Tianming was really in the Western Zhou Dynasty."

Hearing this, everyone in the 749th Bureau command center was completely speechless.

A picture seemed to appear in their minds.

A lonely figure wearing black armor, with divine eyes on his forehead, and holding two whips, stood alone in front of the two armies.

Opposite him were the thousands of troops and horses of Chanjiao, and the legendary Twelve Golden Immortals.

But he, with one person's power, propped up the entire crumbling Shang Dynasty and the fate of the entire Jiejiao.

How tragic this is!What a passion!

"Then... what happened next?" Wang Bin couldn't help but ask, "Didn't he... die in the battle?"

Yang Jian's voice became more bitter.

"Yes...and no."

"Master Wen Zhong finally exhausted his strength and mistakenly entered Juelong Ridge. This was a fate and beyond the reach of human beings."

"But at the moment when his body died and his soul was about to be on the list of gods, a change... happened."

"The sixth generation ancestor of the Evergreen Immortal Sect has appeared."

"No one knows who he is, no one knows where he came from. He only did one thing."

"He snatched Grand Master Wen Zhong's true spirit back from the list of gods and from the rules of heaven."

"He snatched Grand Master Wen Zhong's true spirit back from the list of gods and from the rules of heaven."

Yang Jian's words were extremely difficult to say.

Every word seemed to be as heavy as a thousand stones, hitting the hearts of everyone in the 749th Bureau Command Center.

"Snatch...snatch it back?"

Zhou Xuance's mouth was wide enough to fit an egg in. He felt that there might be something wrong with his hearing.

"Robbing people from the list of gods? This...what does this mean?"

The old Heavenly Master's face could no longer be described as pale. It was a flush that was mixed with extreme fear and extreme fanaticism.

He gripped the edge of the table tightly, his knuckles turning white from the exertion, and explained in a trembling voice:

"The List of Conferred Gods... is a magical weapon of heaven! It is a supreme treasure given by Taoist Ancestor Hongjun to stabilize the order of heaven and earth and end the catastrophe of immortality!"

"Once an immortal dies, his true spirit will be automatically absorbed by the list of gods, ranked on it, and transformed into the righteous god of heaven. This process is a direct manifestation of the laws of heaven, and it is irreversible and cannot be defied!"

"To disobey is to be an enemy of Heavenly Dao! It is to be an enemy to Daoist Hongjun!"

When the old master said this, he took a sharp breath. He looked at the screen as if he were looking at a madman.

"The sixth generation ancestor of the Evergreen Immortal Sect...he...he dares to snatch people from the list of gods? He is...blatantly challenging Tiandao!"

"Oh my god..."

There was a gasp of air in the command center.

They finally understood why Yang Jian was so afraid.

What kind of sect is this!

The founder of the fifth generation fought against the entire Chan Sect with one person.

The sixth-generation patriarch is so fierce that he directly competes with Tiandao for people!

This can no longer be described by the word "powerful".

This is crazy!They are a group of lawless lunatics who do not follow common sense!

And now, the twentieth generation descendant of this crazy sect is standing here.

Who can not be afraid?Who dares not to be afraid?

Yang Jian's voice, with the lingering fear of memories, continued to come from outside.

"The Sixth Generation Patriarch didn't stay long after he snatched Grand Master Wen Zhong's true spirit back. He just said a word to Uncle Jiang Ziya who was holding the list of gods, as well as to all the Immortals who were present including me."

"He said..." Yang Jian's voice paused, seeming to be imitating the tone of the sixth-generation patriarch.

"'The reason for today, three thousand years later, I, the Evergreen Immortal Sect, will come to get a result.'"

"After saying that, he took Taishi Wen Zhong's true spirit and disappeared between heaven and earth. From then on, the Evergreen Immortal Sect completely disappeared from the world, and there was no news about it for three thousand years."

"Until...today."

Yang Jian’s story is over.

But the shock it brought was like a tsunami, impacting everyone's hearts wave after wave.

The reason for today is that three thousand years later, I, the Evergreen Immortal Sect, will come to get a result.

What a domineering declaration!

In the Battle of the Gods, the Chan Sect was victorious, the Jie Sect was destroyed, and the Heavenly Court was established. This was the outcome decided by Heaven.

But the Evergreen Immortal Sect refused to recognize him!

He snatched away Wen Zhongtai, who was supposed to be on the list of gods.

He left behind a harsh word that he would come back to settle accounts three thousand years later.

This means: You have made me unhappy today, and this matter is not over yet.You have been proud for three thousand years, and after three thousand years, I will come to you to get my money back with interest!

How domineering this is!What lawlessness!
